item.title: Syria says one killed, 36 wounded after Damascus blasts during Macron visit
item.description: Macron, who continued his visit after the blasts, said Syria must not be 'destabilised' by the attacks.

item.description: Both sides have accused each other of violating the memorandum of understanding signed in June.

item.title: Funeral events for Iran’s slain Supreme Leader Khamenei under way in Iraq

item.description: The devastation that industrial facilities have taken from two wars in a year might take years to reverse, say analysts.

item.description: Speaking ahead of a Nato summit, the president says US negotiators can keep talking with the Iranians "if they want".

item.description: The US has launched the strikes on Iran in response to attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
item.description: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.
